# WebABC

> WebABC (https://webabc.ir) is a premier web design, full-stack custom development, performance SEO, and AI engine optimization (AEO/GEO) agency serving clients across the Middle East (Dubai, Tehran, Muscat, Riyadh, Abu Dhabi, Qazvin) and internationally. Built on Astro for ultra-fast performance, zero-JS baseline rendering, and optimal AI crawling readability. The site is published in English (`/en`), Persian (`/fa`), and Arabic (`/ar`).

## Company & Overview

- [Home](https://webabc.ir/en): Overview of WebABC's services, agency workflow, technology stack, and client case studies.
- [About Us](https://webabc.ir/en/about): Agency background, engineering standards, and team profile.
- [Contact & Consultation](https://webabc.ir/en/contact): Inquiry form and direct consultation request.
- [FAQ](https://webabc.ir/en/faq): Answer Engine Optimized (AEO) FAQs regarding project timelines, pricing, and tech stacks.
- [Privacy Policy](https://webabc.ir/en/privacy): GDPR-compliant privacy and data handling practices.
- [Security Policy](https://webabc.ir/.well-known/security.txt): Vulnerability reporting policy and security contacts.

## Core Services

- [Services Overview](https://webabc.ir/en/services): Directory of specialized web design, engineering, and organic growth services.
- [SEO & Growth](https://webabc.ir/en/services/seo): Enterprise technical SEO, on-page optimization, entity search, and Schema markup.
- [Local SEO](https://webabc.ir/en/services/local-seo): Localized search optimization, Google Business Profile management, and regional citations.
- [Web Development](https://webabc.ir/en/services/web-development): Custom full-stack Web Application development (Astro, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Cloudflare Edge).
- [WordPress Development](https://webabc.ir/en/services/wordpress-development): Custom WordPress themes, WooCommerce storefronts, and headless CMS architecture.
- [Web Design (UI/UX)](https://webabc.ir/en/services/web-design): High-conversion UX design, design systems, visual branding, and mobile responsiveness.
- [E-commerce Development](https://webabc.ir/en/services/ecommerce): High-speed e-commerce stores, custom checkout flows, and payment integrations.
- [Content Strategy & Creation](https://webabc.ir/en/services/content-creation): Semantic SEO content writing, multilingual strategy, and authority blogging.
- [Link Building & Outreach](https://webabc.ir/en/services/link-building): High-authority backlink acquisition and digital PR campaigns.
- [Speed & Performance Optimization](https://webabc.ir/en/services/speed-optimization): Core Web Vitals optimization, TTFB reduction, edge caching, and asset minification.
- [UI/UX Diagnostic Audit](https://webabc.ir/en/services/ui-ux-audit): Comprehensive UX usability, conversion rate, and accessibility audits.
- [Website Maintenance & Security](https://webabc.ir/en/services/website-maintenance): 24/7 uptime monitoring, security hardening, automated backups, and software updates.

## Interactive Tools (Free Developer & SEO Utilities)

- [All Developer & SEO Tools](https://webabc.ir/en/tools): Interactive client-side web utilities for developers, marketers, and content creators.
- [SEO Headline Analyzer](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/headline-analyzer): Score headlines for emotional impact, character length, and CTR.
- [SEO Title & Meta Preview](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/seo-title-checker): Real-time Google SERP title tag and meta description snippet simulator.
- [Website Cost Calculator](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/cost-calculator): Instant interactive budget estimation for web design and development.
- [Content Readability Checker](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/readability-checker): Flesch-Kincaid grade level and reading ease analyzer.
- [Keyword Density Analyzer](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/keyword-density-analyzer): Detect keyword frequency and prevent over-optimization penalties.
- [URL Slug Generator](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/slug-generator): Clean, special-character-free SEO URL slug formatter.
- [UTM Link Builder](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/utm-builder): Campaign URL generator with analytics parameter tracking.
- [SERP Snippet Preview](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/serp-preview): Desktop and mobile search result preview simulator.
- [Social Media Card Preview](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/social-media-preview): Open Graph and Twitter Card validator.
- [Privacy Policy Generator](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/privacy-policy-generator): Instant custom GDPR/CCPA privacy policy document maker.
- [CSS Glassmorphism Generator](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/glassmorphism-generator): Interactive CSS backdrop-filter and UI code generator.
- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/json-formatter): Secure, client-side JSON formatting and syntax validation.
- [Robots.txt Generator](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/robots-generator): Custom crawler directive rules generator.
- [People Also Ask (PAA) Explorer](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/paa-scraper): Question research tool for AEO and featured snippet targeting.
- [Schema Markup Generator](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/schema-generator): Structured data JSON-LD generator for Organization, Service, and FAQ schemas.
- [FAQ Schema Generator](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/faq-generator): Create Schema.org FAQPage structured data markup.
- [Base64 Encoder/Decoder](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/base64-encoder): Client-side string and asset Base64 converter.
- [Box Shadow Generator](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/box-shadow-generator): Custom CSS shadow code design tool.
- [Color Contrast Checker](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/color-contrast-checker): WCAG compliance accessibility color contrast tester.
- [CSS Gradient Generator](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/css-gradient-generator): Linear and radial CSS gradient design tool.
- [Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/lorem-generator): Placeholder text generator for designers and developers.
- [Meta Tag Generator](https://webabc.ir/en/tools/meta-generator): Complete HTML head meta tags builder.
